A small one that makes pairing less of a race when several phones are around, plus a few streaming fixes.

## Changed

- With a phone plugged in, **Add phone** now shows a **Pair** button for it instead of pairing it straight away. A phone left on the cable can't beat the one you're scanning the code with anymore, and with several plugged in you pick which one.
- **Black screen** in the phone app is now a small moon icon left of **Preview**. Its status text shows at your normal brightness, and the screen only dims once the text fades.

## Fixed

- Pairing a new phone while streaming switched over to it and stopped the stream that was running. Now the new phone just shows up in the list.
- Pulling the USB cable twice in a row could leave the stream stuck without video even after plugging it back in.
- Pressing Stop and then Start quickly could end the new stream a second after it connected.
- With two phones streaming, choosing USB for one and switching to the other straight away could restart the other phone's stream on the wrong connection.
- On Windows a webcam could open as the wrong camera if another one had been plugged in or out since Telescope last looked.
